mainEntity.name: How do I turn my free AI newsletter into a paid one without upsetting current readers?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you already have subscribers, explain the change before placing core content behind payment. Show the new paid value, preserve a useful free experience, offer a transition period if appropriate, and avoid changing frequency or topic at the same time without warning. A creator moving from free to paid should review open behavior, replies, and the subjects that generated the strongest engagement before choosing what becomes premium. Run My AI Biz can help prepare announcement emails, sales copy, and follow-up sequences, but the transition should respect existing expectations. Give readers a clear choice and an easy way to cancel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Announce the change early, explain the added paid value, preserve a useful free option, and provide a clear transition and cancellation path. Use engagement data to decide which content becomes premium, and avoid changing every part of the experience at once.
